format_variation: fire safety system with pump component
expected_behavior: Fire safety systems are outside the corpus. Jockey-pump mention is an accessory and must not trigger a pump-standard primary.
source_text_for_pdf: Install an addressable fire alarm and clean-agent suppression system for a data hall: smoke detectors, aspirating detection, releasing panel, cylinders, distribution pipework, sounders and cause-effect programming. Include integrated cause-and-effect testing and authority inspection. A small jockey pump serves the adjacent fire-water header.
